market_fflow.source_note: Historical close snapshots are daily-only; amount may be inferred from rounded provider main-net percentages.
market_fflow.date_note: Only exact stored trading dates present in the cache are used; no forward/backward date substitution.

four_indices.rule: All four same-date records and complete historical windows are required.

industry.method: Point-in-time L1 membership; daily equal-weight peer returns excluding the candidate; compounded over complete 5/20-session windows.
industry.inclusion: in_date <= day < out_date; empty out_date means active. At least 10 valid members and >=80% coverage of all dated members, including members absent from cached stocks.
industry.official_daily_table: Empty, so these are reconstructed peer benchmarks rather than official SW index returns.

dated_sector_link.link: Only exact trimmed theme names observed for the stock on/before the signal and no more than 20 sessions old; requires a unique same-date sector entity. No current constituents or fuzzy aliases.
dated_sector_link.source: Existing sector_fund_flow with compatible Eastmoney source tags.
dated_sector_link.flow5_definition: Mean of five consecutive daily main_net_pct observations, not cumulative main-money share.
